card.name: Dose-change instructions in drug interactions
card.fires_on: Words just before an instruction to change the dose, in drug-interaction text about CYP3A inhibitors or inducers. Often the comma after 'cannot be avoided' or the word 'the' after 'Reduce'.

modes.label: Comma after unavoidable use
modes.description: The comma ending an 'if use cannot be avoided' clause, right before reduce or increase the dose.
modes.example: If concomitant use cannot be avoided<<,>> reduce VEPPANU dosage.

modes.label: Inside drug or enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through a brand name or enzyme name in a concomitant-use sentence.

modes.description: The word right after Reduce, before the drug's dosage.

card.plain: It fires in interaction warnings just before the text says to change the dose.
